schedule_block_minutes_valid.name: schedule_block_minutes_valid
schedule_block_minutes_valid.value: "schedule_block"."start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "schedule_block"."end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "schedule_block"."end_minute" > "schedule_block"."start_minute"

schedule_block_date_xor_cadence.name: schedule_block_date_xor_cadence
schedule_block_date_xor_cadence.value: ("schedule_block"."planned_date" IS NOT NULL) != ("schedule_block"."cadence" IS NOT NULL)

schedule_block_ends_at_only_repeating.name: schedule_block_ends_at_only_repeating
schedule_block_ends_at_only_repeating.value: "schedule_block"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "schedule_block"."cadence" IS NOT NULL

user_work_schedule_minutes_valid.name: user_work_schedule_minutes_valid
user_work_schedule_minutes_valid.value: "user_work_schedule"."work_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "user_work_schedule"."work_end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "user_work_schedule"."work_end_minute" > "user_work_schedule"."work_start_minute"

user_work_schedule_lunch_valid.name: user_work_schedule_lunch_valid
user_work_schedule_lunch_valid.value:
NOT "user_work_schedule"."lunch_enabled" OR (
        "user_work_schedule"."lunch_start_minute" IS NOT NULL AND "user_work_schedule"."lunch_end_minute" IS NOT NULL
        AND "user_work_schedule"."lunch_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439
        AND "user_work_schedule"."lunch_end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440
        AND "user_work_schedule"."lunch_end_minute" > "user_work_schedule"."lunch_start_minute"
      )
